universities.name: Karolinska Institutet

profile.ug_entry: HSC/equivalent plus required science subjects; English UG options are limited.
profile.pg_entry: Relevant Bachelor’s degree; biomedical/health-related or other specified credits may be required.
profile.english: English 6 equivalent; IELTS 6.5 is a common route. Check exact programme score and bands.
profile.courses: UG: Biomedicine. PG: Biomedicine, Global Health, Public Health Sciences, Health Informatics, Health Economics, Nutrition Science.
profile.fees: UG Biomedicine: about SEK 540,000 total for 3 years. PG fees vary by programme.
profile.scholarship: KI Global Master’s Scholarship: competitive tuition support for selected Master’s students; Swedish Institute awards may apply to eligible applicants.
profile.ug_gpa: No university-wide numeric GPA/CGPA cutoff is published for general bachelor's eligibility. Bangladesh HSC is accepted for general eligibility; applicants graduating after 2009 must have passed Mathematics. Programme-specific subject prerequisites and selection rules apply. Source: https://www.universityadmissions.se/en/apply-to-bachelors/provide-application-documents-bachelors/country-instructions/bangladesh/
profile.pg_gpa: No single university-wide GPA/CGPA cutoff is published for general master's eligibility. Bangladesh applicants normally need a 4-year bachelor's degree, or bachelor's followed by master's (total 4 years); some 3-year honours degrees in specified fields may qualify. Programme-specific prerequisites and selection apply. Source: https://www.universityadmissions.se/en/apply-to-masters/provide-application-documents-masters/country-instructions/bangladesh/

universities.name: Lund University

profile.ug_entry: HSC/equivalent and programme-specific subject requirements; English-taught Bachelor’s choices are fewer than Master’s.
